name: knobwork
description: Research, emulation, and reversible-overlay tools for Gen 6 infotainment head units

scripts.check: node --check emulation/harness/verify_ui.js && for f in emulation/ui_harness/main.js emulation/ui_harness/lib/*.js emulation/ui_harness/public/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node emulation/ui_harness/tools/repo-check.js
scripts.mutate: for g in boundaries frames scenario lifecycle proxy; do STRYKER_GROUP=$g npx stryker run emulation/ui_harness/stryker.config.mjs || exit 1; done
